about: Middle school Breakfast @ Break, typed in from the school's sheet for the 2026-27 school year. Months are 1-12. Days are Monday to Friday. If the school posts a new sheet, the build warns and the site links to it; update this file from the new sheet and set source to its address.
note: Breakfast @ Break is for middle school only. Students choose one: breakfast before school or Breakfast @ Break.
